# Test fixtures

## power_monthly_cairo.json — REAL NASA POWER response

An unmodified response body from the NASA POWER Monthly and Annual API.

- Retrieved: 2026-11-14
- Request: `GET https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/monthly/point?parameters=T2M,PRECTOTCORR&community=ag&longitude=31.25&latitude=30.05&start=2025&end=2026&format=JSON`
- Location: 30.05 N, 31.25 E (Cairo area)
- Why this request: it contains fill values (`-999.0`) for months not yet
  available, a real zero precipitation value, and an annual (`13`) key for the
  complete year only.

Do not edit this file by hand. To refresh it, repeat the request and update
the date above and the expected values in `tests/test_power_client.py`.

## Synthetic data

Synthetic payloads are built inside the tests (`_synthetic_payload`) and are
labelled as such. They are not NASA data and are never stored here as if they
were.
